paragraphs: BEUMER Group builds material handling systems, among them the baggage handling and sortation equipment used in airport terminals. The company reports more than 6,000 employees in more than 70 countries.

Service is handled through a worldwide network of regional service centers that stay with a system across its lifecycle. A locations page lists a German site at Oelder Str. 40 in Beckum. The same page lists a United States address at 800 Apgar Drive, Somerset, New Jersey. A startup incubator called Beam has been building software-focused companies aimed at logistics problems.

The company describes itself as independent and family-owned, and commits to the principles of sustainable development. It states that it committed to the Science Based Targets Initiative in 2023. Away from logistics, it is the official main and shirt partner of FC Schalke 04.

quote.text: As an independent and family-owned company, BEUMER Group is deeply committed to the principles of sustainable development.
